D.t: Chris Coons leads by 25.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 104,814 votes; a one point swing is about 2,090 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +16.2 and D +33.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The biggest vote banks for Democrats: New Castle, a projected net 104,660 votes; Kent, a projected net 6,780 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Sussex, R +5.6, 28.1% of the vote; Kent, D +9.5, 17.1% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Chris Coons runs furthest behind in Sussex, Kent. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.
